title: FurryGhor — Bangladesh's First Pet Hotel | Khalid Farhan | Khalid Farhan
metaDesc: FurryGhor is Bangladesh's first dog and cat boarding hotel, founded by Khalid Farhan. Two branches in Mirpur and Gulshan, Dhaka — 24/7 care, private cabins, and a home away from home for your pets.

blocks.text: A KHALID FARHAN VENTURE · DHAKA, BANGLADESH
FurryGhor is a home away from home for your cats and dogs. Two branches across Dhaka — professional care, private cabins, and 24/7 monitoring for every animal that stays with us.

blocks.alt: FurryGhor pet hotel facility in Dhaka
Dogs at FurryGhor dog hostel Bangladesh

blocks.text: “A home for pets away from home.”
A problem every pet owner in Dhaka knew too well.

Before FurryGhor, pet owners leaving Dhaka had nowhere safe to turn. You'd leave your dog or cat with a neighbour, a relative who wasn't sure what to do, or simply cancel your trip. There was no professional solution.

blocks.alt: FurryGhor interior — pet boarding facility Dhaka

blocks.text: Built by pet owners, for pet owners

FurryGhor was founded by a group of pet owners who faced the same problem firsthand. When you love your animals, leaving them behind is the hardest part of any trip. We built the place we always wished existed.
Bangladesh's first — and still the best

When FurryGhor opened, there was no such thing as a pet hotel in Bangladesh. We created the category. Since then we've grown to two branches, served hundreds of animals, and helped pet owners travel without guilt.
More than just a place to stay
Every animal that comes to FurryGhor gets attention, play, structure, and care. We send photo updates. We follow feeding routines. We treat your pet the way you would if you were home.
Every kind of care your pet might need.
From overnight stays to international relocation paperwork — FurryGhor handles it all under one roof.

blocks.alt: Cat staying at FurryGhor pet hostel Dhaka

blocks.text: Short and long-term stays for cats in private, comfortable cabins with dedicated litter stations, play areas, and attentive care.

blocks.alt: Dog boarding at FurryGhor dog hostel Dhaka

blocks.text: Sky-view mini apartments for dogs with buddy play programmes, 24/7 monitoring, and expert attendants — built for dogs who love company.
Hourly care for when you need a few hours out. Drop your pet off, run your day, come back to a happy animal.
Handling pet authorisation, airport transfers, and veterinary documentation for owners relocating abroad with their pets.
The standard isn't standard anywhere else in Dhaka.
Every animal — cat or dog, one night or three weeks — gets the same level of care.
A trained team is present around the clock — nights included. Your pet is never left unattended.
Each pet gets their own space. No shared enclosures, no unnecessary stress.
Expert hands-on care with multiple attendants assigned to every animal.
Regular updates sent directly to you so you can check in from anywhere in the world.
Structured social play sessions for dogs who thrive with company.
Designed around animal psychology — calm spaces, familiar routines, and constant attention.
Whether you're in Mirpur or heading through Gulshan — there's a FurryGhor close to you.
The original location. Situated near Mirpur Zoo, easy access from across Dhaka.
The second branch, serving Gulshan, Banani, and surrounding areas.
Your pet deserves more than a favour.
Whether you're leaving for a weekend or relocating abroad, FurryGhor gives your cat or dog a proper home while you're away. Professional care. Real peace of mind.

Bangladesh's first dog and cat hotel.
Mirpur & Gulshan, Dhaka.
